disagreements.text: Went back through the club results going back to 2012. Every single year the number of people who enter the spring marathon and don't start it sits between 18 and 23 percent. It's not a bad-luck year, it's the base rate.
Times are down about 3% since the shoe rules changed, so obviously the shoes are the whole story and the sport has a problem.
Every injury thread on this forum is the same injury and the same three replies.
